what: every group of order 96 in the GAP SmallGroups library, as faithful permutation generators — the full portfolio for a Cayley sweep
reading: `generators` are the images of 0..degree-1 under a faithful permutation representation, which `oplab.cayley`'s `permutation` family closes into the multiplication table; the invariants beside them were recomputed from that table when this file was written and are re-checked on every load, so no claim here rests on GAP: the id is provenance, the group is the table. `ambiguous` counts the signature classes that hold more than one group — sharing an invariant signature is necessary, not sufficient, for being isomorphic, so those classes are what the signature does not separate.
